title: Marta's Wheel
summary: Marta's lead wagon threw a wheel on the road. Eight sticks get her rolling again, and she pays in road news.
ask: Marta: You there. Hunter? Good. Hunters have arms.
Marta: The lead wagon threw a wheel and the spokes went to splinters. Eight sticks and I'm rolling again.

done: Marta: That'll do. Ugly spokes roll the same as pretty ones.
Marta: Now. You look like someone who wants to know where things are.
Marta: Gates open out past the walls most weeks. Their light stands up over the trees, day or night.
Marta: The old vaults hum where the land's been cleared, and their doors read you. And the Wayfarers up the north road always need hands.
Marta: That's your map. Free, this once.
